book.name: Lɛme
book.title: Ŋwa wu Lɛme chi booŋ ba ntuŋ ba Jiso

content: Bamii ba mbɛmɛ shii nshilɛ Yɛlusalɛm
Bamii bamu gɛ̀ ja Judia, bo boh bo to Antiok, bo tu bo yɛyi bamii ba mbɛmɛ, lɛ gɛ taŋlo Nyo bvusɛ muh njɛ ba chvuu mwɛdɛ yeh no nchi wu Musɛ duunyi sɛŋ gɛ.

Bol bɛ Banaba kajɛ lo n'yɛyɛ wuyu, bɛ bamii bayu she bo tɛɛnyi kintɛɛnyɛ yu we nyu gɛ kì wɛɛ gɛ. Fi gɛ̀ ya, kintaashɛ ki bamii ba mbɛmɛ ki Antiok bo baa Bol bɛ Banaba mo bamii ba mbɛmɛ bamu, bo tuŋ lɛ bo bɛɛŋ Yɛlusalɛm bo yɛŋ booŋ ba ntuŋ ba Jiso bɛ bikwɛɛ bi kintaashɛ ki bamii ba mbɛmɛ ki yo le, lɛ bo lee jwe fɛ fiɛɛ fiyu le.

Noo, kintaashɛ ki bamii ba mbɛmɛ ki Antiok mo ki chiiŋsɛ bo, bo tu bo gɛɛne bo fede bimbe bì Fonishia bɛ bì Samaliya le bo sɛŋe bamii ba mbɛmɛ ba yo le, lɛ bamii ba le gɛ Bajuu gɛ le bo kusɛ wa. Bamii bachii ba gɛ̀ yuge noo, bo tu bo laŋeye baaŋ.
Bo bɛɛŋ bo gɛɛŋ bo fɛsɛ Yɛlusalɛm, kintaashɛ ki bamii ba mbɛmɛ bɛ booŋ ba ntuŋ ba Jiso mo bachiji kintaashɛ ki yo fi bo. Bo sɛɛŋ fiɛɛ fichii bo le no Nyo chi lɛŋ chiaaŋ yiboo le.
Geenɛ, bamii ba mbɛmɛ bamu bo gɛ̀ bee tɛ a ŋgoo yi Bafalashii le, ja we bo jɛmɛ lɛ, “Ba kɛme gɛh ki ba chvûuse bamii ba le gɛ Bajuu gɛ yeh, bo jɛ̂mɛ bo le lɛ bo bii banchi ba Musɛ le.”
No bo jɛmɛ noo, booŋ ba ntuŋ ba Jiso bɛ bachiji kintaashɛ ka bo shii ki bo lee antɛnɛɛ a fiɛɛ fiyu.

Bo gɛ̀ she bo jɛme bo gɛɛŋ je yì ndefɛ le, Bita ja wu lɛɛŋ we wu jɛmɛ lɛ, “Booŋ ba bwɛɛŋ, bɛŋ kee lɛ gɛ̀ bee fweele Nyo baa mɛ a bɛŋ ntɛnɛɛ lɛ le yi jwe waŋ le wù bamii ba le gɛ Bajuu gɛ le bo yuge saaka wù joŋe bo bɛmɛ wu le.
Nyo wù kee muntele mu bamii, wu dunyɛ lɛ wu lé wu fi bamii ba le gɛ Bajuu gɛ, wu nya bo bɛ Kiyo ki Yuude yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no wu gɛh nya besabɛŋ le.
Wu gɛ̀ baaŋ dunyɛ gɛ yeye besabɛŋ le bɛ bamii bayu le gɛ. Wu gɛ̀ ge muntele muboo tu mu yuude njɛ bo gɛ̀ bee bo leesɛ muntele yi Jiso le.
No fi le noo, bɛŋ jiɛnyi nɛɛ fɛ bɛŋ goone ki bɛŋ shîŋshi fitele fì Nyo, bɛŋ jode bvujijɛ bɛŋ gɛɛde yi ŋgoo yi bamii ba mbɛmɛ le, bvujijɛ bvunɛ gɛ̀ ya wa bee mo bachiji chiji besa?
Gɛ fi nyume chuule gɛ. Besabɛŋ le be bɛɛŋ lɛ Nyo bvuuse besabɛŋ nje fitele fì joŋe fì Tada Jiso le wu dunyɛ fɛ besabɛŋ le. Nyu gɛh tɛ yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no wu bvuuse bamii ba le gɛ Bajuu gɛ.”

No Bita jɛme wu mɛsɛ, bamii bachii chiifɛ, bo tu bo yege no Banaba bɛ Bol jɛme no bo gɛ̀ jiɛnyi bo gɛɛne fɛ bamii ba le gɛ Bajuu le gɛ, Nyo nyaa bo bɛ bvuŋga lɛ bo gêe mwɛɛ mù duunyi bvuŋga bvu Nyo bɛ mwɛɛ mu de yì yunɛ.
Bo jɛmɛ bo mɛsɛ, Jɛm mo wu jɛmɛ lɛ, “Booŋ ba bwɛɛŋ, bɛŋ yêgɛ bɛŋ yû fiɛɛ fì nle njɛmɛ.
Samoŋ be wu sɛɛŋ wa besabɛŋ le no Nyo gɛ̀ kɛ wu dunyɛ tɛ kiŋkoŋɛ ke fɛ bamii ba le gɛ Bajuu le gɛ, wu cha bamu a bo ntɛnɛɛ lɛ le bamii be.
Fiɛɛ fì bamii ba ntuŋ wu Nyo gɛ̀ saŋ jiɛnyi gɛh kikaa kimimia bɛ fì Nyo gɛ̀ ge. Ba gɛ̀ saŋ lɛ,

content.text: ‘Kife too lo kì nlé ŋgê ŋkâasɛ ntô,
ŋkɛnyɛ yeh yi Dabi yì le yi gwe wa.
Noo, kimbɛge ki bamii mo ki goone Tada,
bamii banɛ bachii nyu bamii ba le gɛ Bajuu gɛ ba nle ncha,
wu gɛ̀ ge wa bamii kɛɛ baaŋ lo nchensɛŋ.’

content: N'yɛnɛ fiaŋ lɛ keefɛ besabɛŋ nyâa ŋgɛ bamii ba le gɛ Bajuu bò le bo leesɛ fitele yi Nyo le gɛ.

Besabɛŋ saŋ gɛh nyu ŋwa fɛ bo le, lɛ keefɛ bo jîi mwɛɛ mù ba le ba ge bintanyɛ yu fɛ banyo le gɛ, nje le mwɛɛ mu nyiɛnɛ. Keefɛ bo kɛ̂me fiɛɛ fì bo gee bɛ kinjaŋ gɛ. Keefɛ bo jîi nyáŋ njɛ ba sɛɛ kilɛmɛ bu sɛŋ gɛ. Keefɛ bo jîi kilɛmɛ ki nyaŋ gɛ.
Ba saŋ noo, nje banchi ba Musɛ banɛ ba gɛ̀ yɛyɛ wa nchensɛŋ manjuu le manchii bamii yuge, le gɛh bo ba bo tɛŋe abɛŋ yéh yi buunɛ le aju a yuuŋ le achii.”
Bo saŋ ŋwa fɛ bamii ba mbɛmɛ ba le gɛ Bajuu le gɛ

Noo, booŋ ba ntuŋ ba Jiso bɛ bachiji kintaashɛ mo kintaashɛ ki bamii ba mbɛmɛ kichii bɛɛŋ fiɛɛ fiyu, bo mo bo yɛŋ lɛ fi joŋe lɛ bo baa bamii a bo ntɛnɛɛ bo tuŋ bɛ ba Banaba mo Bol bo gɛɛŋ Antiok. Bo mo bo baa Juda wù jee che chimi gɛ̀ bee lɛ Basaba, bo ka bo baa tɛ Sila. Bamii bafɛɛ banɛ gɛ̀ bee bikwɛɛ antɛnɛɛ a bamii ba mbɛmɛ.

Bo saŋ ŋwa wù ba lé ba tûŋ bo yu wu le lɛ, “Bee booŋ ba bwe wene ba le booŋ ba ntuŋ ba Jiso bɛ bachiji kintaashɛ yɛɛse bɛŋ bamii ba mbɛmɛ bachii ba le gɛ Bajuu gɛ, ba le a kilaantɛŋ kì Antiok le bɛ ba le kimbe kì Silia le mo ba le a kì Silisia le.
Bee le be yu lɛ bamii bamu le bo bu a bee ntɛnɛɛ bo to bo tu bo nyaa ŋgɛ, bo chɛŋe bɛ bvufee bwena bɛ n'yɛyɛ wumu njɛ le bee be tuŋ bo sɛŋ.
Noo, bee mo be shii bachii bee bɛɛŋ lɛ ba baa bamii bamu ba tuŋ fɛ bɛŋ le, bo tôo bɛ ba Banaba mo Bol bo le nsáa yese yi shɛ́ŋ.
Bamii banɛ le bo nya wa kinche kiboo nje lɛme chi Tada wese besabɛŋ wù Jiso Kletu le.
Bee mo be tuŋ Juda bɛ Sila lɛ bo to bo jɛmɛ tɛ bɛ jwe fiɛɛ fì le a ŋwa wunɛ le.
Besa ba Kiyo ki Yuude le be yɛŋ lɛ fi baaŋ joŋ gɛ ki bee yigɛ bɛŋ bɛ bvujijɛ bvumu fede banchi ba shaŋ banɛ ba le lɛ:

Keefɛ bɛŋ jîi mwɛɛ munjile mù ba le ba ge bintanyɛ yu fɛ banyo le gɛ. Keefɛ bɛŋ jîi kilɛmɛ ki nyaŋ gɛ. Keefɛ bɛŋ jîi nyaŋ njɛ ba sɛɛ kilɛmɛ bu sɛŋ gɛ. Keefɛ bɛŋ kɛ̂me fiɛɛ fì bɛŋ gee bɛ kinjaŋ gɛ. Bɛŋ nɛ lege mwɛɛ munɛ, tu bɛŋ gee chuule. Ba shɛɛ wa.”
Bo gɛ̀ saŋ noo bo mo bo tuŋ bamii baa yu bo boh Antiok. Bo gɛɛŋ, bo kuŋ kintaashɛ ki bamii ba mbɛmɛ ki yo kichii, bo nya ŋwa wɛɛ bo le.
Bo tɛɛŋ ŋwa wɛɛ, saaka wuyu jiɛɛsɛ muntele muboo, bo yu njoŋ baaŋ.
Juda bɛ Sila gɛ̀ bee bamii ba gɛ̀ sɛŋe mwɛɛ mù bo gɛ̀ yuge Nyo jɛmɛ, bo nya nteefe yì duude bamii ba mbɛmɛ le, bo tu bo kɛme bvuŋga a muntele le.
Bo che yo yi kife kimu le. Bamii ba mbɛmɛ gɛ̀ chiiŋsɛ bo, bo tu bo kaase bɛ kimbonɛ bo tuu jiŋ fɛ bamii ba gɛ̀ tuŋ bo le.
Bol bɛ Banaba mɛ gɛh Antiok, bɛ bamii bamu yɛyi bo ka feeji jɛ yi Tada.
Bol bɛ Banaba gasɛ
Kife gɛ̀ doo ki kɛŋsɛ, Bol jɛmɛ Banaba le lɛ, “Besa wo kaasɛ be tu jiŋ be jiɛnyɛ bilaantɛŋ bi besa wo chi feeji jɛ yi Tada bi le, be yɛŋ laa bamii ba mbɛmɛ ba yo gee nɛɛ la.”
Banaba mo wu goone ki wu jô Joŋ Maliku lɛ bɛ bo jiɛnyɛ.
Geenɛ, Bol faŋ wu koŋe gɛ lɛ bo jo wu gɛ, nje wù gɛ̀ bee wu chinɛ bo le Banfilia wu faŋ ki wu mɛ̂sɛ njiɛnyɛ wu bɛ bo gɛ kɛmɛ.
Bol bɛ Banaba gɛ̀ she bo kɛmɛ kintɛɛnyɛ baaŋ, bo mo bo gasɛ. Banaba jo Maliku, bɛ wu lee a ŋguh wu a joo le, bo gɛɛŋ Sablu.
Bol cha fie nyu Sila. Bɛ wu doo bo jade, bamii ba mbɛmɛ nya bo chiaaŋ yi nfii wu Tada le.
Bo gɛɛŋ je bimbe bi Silia bɛ bì Silisia le, bo tu bo jiɛnyi bo chiaase muntele mu kintaashɛ ki bamii ba mbɛmɛ.

footnotes.text: Baŋwa ba kege bamu kɛme kinchiŋ kinɛ ki 34, ki le lɛ, “Geenɛ, Sila mɛ gɛh fie Antiok.”
